evidence.quote: 2023 Kab-lem has around 2,000 employees and a turnover of 73 million euros, confirming itself as an international player in the automotive wiring sector. || Production Plants Italy – HQ Wirings Romania Moldova Tunisia CET Tunisia || Kab-lem S.p.A. supplies its products directly and indirectly to the major OEMs at international level like Alfa Romeo, Audi, BMW, Chrysler, Citroën, Ferrari, Fiat, General Motors, Lancia, Maserati, Mercedes, Opel, Peugeot, Renault, Seat, Toyota e Volkswagen.
